entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? This art book went out of[n]print long ago... It's quite old,[n]and extraordinarily rare...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Its content is profound as well,[n]bolder than any works popular in[n]the current times...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have realized a great deal about[n]the direction of art through this[n]book. The work in here is amazing.
It all looks the same to me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There is a chapter here[n]called "Visiting the Old[n]to Discover the New."

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I suppose that is what[n]it truly means to learn[n]from the past.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Look at this. An ukiyo-e artist[n]used the forms of naked men to[n]depict an image of a person.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He titled it "He may look scary,[n]but he is a good person." Quite[n]the nonchalant title, no?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: All I will say is that the soul[n]contained in each portrait is[n]truly quite different.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, the viewer is the[n]ultimate judge. It's not wrong to[n]believe they all appear the same.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Some artists decry their audience[n]as uneducated, but one's personal[n]perception of art is what matters.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... I wonder if I adhere too[n]closely to new ideas in my work...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Once again, I've come to realize[n]the importance of being flexible[n]in my drawing inspiration.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This was a great lesson indeed.[n]Thank you, [fName].

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This art book is quite something...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Five hundred yen!? This fountain[n]of knowledge is available at such[n]an affordable price point!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I do not have enough for the[n]train fare... [fName], won't you[n]walk with me some of the way?
